questions.question: P, Q, R, S and T are sitting on a bench. Q is sitting next to T. S is not sitting with P, who is at the right end of the bench. R is at the second position from the left. T sits second to the right of S. In which position is T sitting?

Clearly, T is sitting between R and Q.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'SOUND' is coded as '219' and 'BRICK' is coded as '172'. How will 'SLACK' be coded in that language?

Logic: Addition of alphabet positional value × number of consonant.

'SOUND' is coded as '219' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59d046d6388afa5e0086e42ee9227ab5dc0b5e2f763165f488a2c5169d3cdd07.png] 

→ Number of consonant → 3

→ 19 + 15 + 21 + 14 + 4 = 73 × 3 = 219

And

→ Number of consonant → 4

→ 2 + 18 + 9 + 3 + 11 = 43 × 4 = 172

→ Number of consonant → 4

→ 19 + 12 +1 + 3 + 11 = 46 × 4 = 184

Hence, the correct answer is "184".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some managers are accountants.

All accountants are auditors.

**Conclusions:**

I. All auditors are accountants.

II. All managers are auditors.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The lest possible Venn diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a88cfcc8e1f635858161f6f4cc93c9e1501743b9540dc11a6a189e09ee786f31.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All auditors are accountants → Does not follow → (As all accountants are auditors. So, all auditors are accountants is does not follow)

II. All managers are auditors → Does not follow → (As some managers are accountants and all accountants are auditors. So, all managers are auditors is possible but not definite true)

Hence, the correct answer is "Neither conclusion I nor II follows".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

36 : 18 :: 75 : ? :: 25 : 14
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Sum of digit of first number × 2 = Second number**

1) 36 : 18

→ 3 + 6 = 9 × 2 = **18**

And,
